agent-instructions.recipe: Read the changed instructions for contradictions with the other references; run tests/test_links.py; behavior changes need a scenario from evals/scenarios.md

installer.recipe: Run tests/test_install.py and install into a disposable repository, then run the installed check-upstream.py

upstream-snapshot.recipe: Run check-upstream.py and byte-compare changed files with the pinned upstream commit

evidence-receipts.recipe: Run tests/test_evidence.py, including its negative controls

coordination.recipe: Run tests/test_coord.py and tests/test_verify_plan.py; exercise changed commands against real GitHub and Conductor with a dry-run program

model-selection.recipe: Run tests/test_usage.py, whose policy test compares usage.POLICY with the models.md table, and tests/test_coord.py, whose roles are built from it; run usage.py --no-probe in a Conductor workspace and compare its readings with the provider's usage page

setup-check.recipe: Run tests/test_setup_check.py, including its negative controls; run setup_check.py --remote on this repository and on a fresh disposable install

repository-tests.recipe: Run the full unittest suite and a negative control for the changed test
